context: Naoko proudly serves a new cheese-based dish; Yumiko tastes.
purpose: Two older women in food experiment.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 姉ちゃん、新しい料理、試して!
lines.en: Hey sis, try this new dish I made!
lines.style: Bright, energetic opening. Sharp attack on the invitation. Warm Kansai warmth underneath the volume. Eager to share — the kind of excitement that expects agreement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: まあ、チーズ、入ってるの?
lines.en: Oh, does it have cheese in it?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity. Soft, interested tone — genuinely wanting to know what her sister made. Warm and open. The question of someone who trusts the cook.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 濃い味、ようけ尽くして作ったで!
lines.en: I loaded it with deep, rich flavors, you know!
lines.style: Louder, more emphatic now. Pride in the execution. Kansai directness — stating it like fact. The chest behind the words. Still warm, but with conviction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 感心するわ、改良してる。
lines.en: I'm impressed — you really do keep improving.
lines.style: Sincere appreciation, no flattery. Spoken with quiet conviction. Slight nod in the voice. The praise of someone who means what she says and doesn't say it lightly.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 気軽に、お客さんに、出せる味や!
lines.en: This is the kind of thing you can serve to anyone, no shame in it.
lines.style: Softer now, more reflective. Pride settling into contentment. Casual certainty — not bragging, just stating what's true. Slight smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: It's lovely — people will really enjoy it.
lines.style: Warm approval. Steady, grounded tone. The confidence of someone who knows people and knows good food. Supportive without being performative.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: おおきに、ほめてくれて!
lines.en: Thank you so much for saying that!
lines.style: Genuine gratitude. Softer than before — the vulnerability of being praised by someone whose opinion matters. Kansai warmth melting into sincerity. Slight catch of pleasure in the voice.
